components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Breaks the sire bond of the one on the centre. The sire stays on record, but the bond is gone.

Only a witch, siphoner, heretic or tribrid can work it. The target must be sired with the bond whole, and Sire's Blood of their own sire must be among the items.

A refusal tells the caster why and gives the ingredients back.
Needs a full moon: the moon must be full (phase 0) between dusk and dawn, in the Overworld. An eclipse counts too. The hub's moon calendar shows when the next one rises.
